15	## 2. Mobile data tables → stacked cards
16	
17	Below `md:` (768px) every table collapses to a vertical card list. Linear's issue list is the gold standard: **title (16/600) on line 1, status dot + assignee avatar + due chip on line 2, priority + project on line 3**. 122	- One-line headline 16/600

128	
129	Scrollable + fade-edge is the consensus. Underline > pill for B2B (Linear, Stripe, Notion all underline). Pill fits consumer/ios-native vibe (Fresha customer app).

134	- Fade edge: `mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, black 16px, black calc(100% - 16px), transparent)`

136	- Min padding per tab: 16px horizontal, 12px vertical (hit-target 44)

138	
139	Pills reserved for segmented controls (e.g., "Day / Week / Month" toggle) — 2–3 options max.

142	
143	Two patterns:
144	- **Inline:** persistent bar at top — for search-primary screens (Clients, Inventory)
145	- **Icon → full-screen overlay:** for secondary search (Bookings, Reports)
146	
147	Linear uses the icon→overlay pattern. Stripe mobile-web: inline sticky. Fresha clients: inline sticky at top of list. Notion: icon in header → full-screen.
148	
149	**InkOS rule:** Clients and Inventory pages ship inline sticky search (`top-14`, below header, `bg-background/80 backdrop-blur`). 1	import { cookies } from 'next/headers'
2	import { redirect } from 'next/navigation'
3	import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
4	import { SidebarProvider } from '@/components/ui/sidebar'
5	import { AppSidebar } from '@/components/app/sidebar/AppSidebar'
6	import { AppHeader } from '@/components/app/sidebar/AppHeader'
7	import { PermissionsProvider } from '@/lib/team/permissions-context'
8	import { getUserPermissions } from '@/lib/team/permissions'
9	import { APP_NAV, type NavRole } from '@/components/app/sidebar/nav-config'
10	import type { PlanTier } from '@/lib/billing/feature-gate'
11	
12	interface AppLayoutProps {
13	  children: React.ReactNode
14	}
15	
16	export default async function AppLayout({ children }: AppLayoutProps) {
17	  const supabase = await createClient()
18	  const {
19	    data: { user },
20	  } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
21	
22	  if (!user) {
23	    redirect('/login')
24	  }
25	
26	  // Fetch profile, studio membership, and studio in parallel
27	  const [profileResult, memberResult] = await Promise.all([
28	    supabase
29	      .from('profiles')
30	      .select('full_name, avatar_url')
31	      .eq('id', user.id)
32	      .single(),
33	    supabase
34	      .from('studio_members')
35	      .select('role, studio_id, studios(id, name, slug, logo_url, plan_id)')
36	      .eq('user_id', user.id)
37	      .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
38	      .limit(1)
39	      .single(),
40	  ])
41	
42	  const profile = profileResult.data
43	  const member = memberResult.data
44	
45	  if (!member) {
46	    redirect('/onboarding')
47	  }
48	
49	  // M11 FIX: Typed helper derived from the select shape instead of `as` cast.
50	  // The query selects studios(id, name, slug, logo_url) — shape is deterministic.
51	  type JoinedStudio = { id: string; name: string; slug: string; logo_url: string | null }
52	  function isJoinedStudio(v: unknown): v is JoinedStudio {
53	    return (
54	      typeof v === 'object' &&
55	      v !== null &&
56	      'name' in v &&
57	      typeof (v as Record<string, unknown>).name === 'string'
58	    )
59	  }
60	
61	  const studio = isJoinedStudio(member.studios) ? member.studios : null
62	
63	  const studioName = studio?.name ?? 'My Studio'
64	  const studioLogoUrl = studio?.logo_url ?? null
65	  const studioId = member.studio_id
66	  const role = member.role as NavRole
67	
68	  // Subscription / plan
69	  let plan: PlanTier = 'solo'
70	  if (studioId) {
71	    const subResult = await supabase
72	      .from('subscriptions')
73	      .select('plan_tier')
74	      .eq('studio_id', studioId)
75	      .eq('status', 'active')
76	      .maybeSingle()
77	    if (subResult.data?.plan_tier) {
78	      plan = subResult.data.plan_tier as PlanTier
79	    }
80	  }
81	
82	  // Location count (for multi-location nav group)
83	  let locationCount = 0
84	  if (studioId) {
85	    const locResult = await supabase
86	      .from('locations')
87	      .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
88	      .eq('studio_id', studioId)
89	    locationCount = locResult.count ?? 0
90	  }
91	
92	  // Permissions — fetched once here, passed to sidebar + context provider
93	  const permissionsSet =
94	    studioId && user ? await getUserPermissions(studioId, user.id) : new Set<string>()
95	  const permissionKeys = [...permissionsSet]
96	
97	  // Sidebar default-open state from cookie
98	  const cookieStore = await cookies()
99	  const sidebarOpen = cookieStore.get('sidebar_state')?.value !== 'false'
100	
101	  const userName = profile?.full_name ?? user.email?.split('@')[0] ?? 'You'
102	  const userEmail = user.email ?? ''
103	  const userAvatarUrl = profile?.avatar_url ?? null
104	
105	  // Compute filtered navGroups for MobileNav (same logic as AppSidebar)
106	  const permissions = new Set(permissionKeys)
107	  const navGroups = APP_NAV
108	    .filter((group) => !(group.condition === 'multi-location' && locationCount <= 1))
109	    .map((group) => ({
110	      ...group,
111	      items: group.items.filter((item) => {
112	        if (!item.requiredRoles.includes(role)) return false
113	        if (item.requiredPermission && !permissions.has(item.requiredPermission)) return false
114	        return true
115	      }),
116	    }))
117	    .filter((group) => group.items.length > 0)
118	
119	  return (
120	    <PermissionsProvider permissionKeys={permissionKeys}>
121	      <SidebarProvider defaultOpen={sidebarOpen} className="h-svh">
122	        <AppSidebar
123	          locationCount={locationCount}
124	          plan={plan}
125	          studioName={studioName}
126	          studioLogoUrl={studioLogoUrl}
127	          role={role}
128	          permissionKeys={permissionKeys}
129	        />
130	        <AppHeader
131	          studioName={studioName}
132	          userName={userName}
133	          userEmail={userEmail}
134	          userAvatarUrl={userAvatarUrl}
135	          navGroups={navGroups}
136	        >
137	          {children}
138	        </AppHeader>
139	      </SidebarProvider>
140	    </PermissionsProvider>
141	  )
142	}
